# Website Positioning

Based only on the 9 crawled pages. No live site was visited.

## Homepage hero
- **Headline (H1):** "Human Intelligence in the age of AI"
- **Subhead:** "We help product and revenue leaders define and execute their product, growth, and AI transformation strategy."
- **Primary call to action:** Not found in the homepage text. The only homepage buttons are five "See how it works" links, one per product card. The header on /ai-accelerator/apply shows "Book a call" (links to cal.com/acme-advisory/intro). It is likely in the header on every page, but the homepage crawl does not confirm it.
- **Browser title:** "Acme Advisory / Human Intelligence for AI-Enabled Product & Revenue Leaders". The title names the audience more clearly than the H1 does.

## Category claimed
There is no single category. The site mixes advice, software tools and workshops. The header menu splits it into "Advisory", "Products" and "Workshops".

- Advisory, from the homepage: "Hands-on advice from someone who has run the function."
- Advisory, from the bio: "Through Acme Advisory, he advises executive teams on AI: where to start, what to build, and how to govern it, with a focus on sales, go-to-market and customer service."
- Advisory menu lines (/ai-accelerator/apply nav):
  - "Product Management discipline for SaaS startup founders"
  - "Product-Led Growth & GTM strategy for revenue leaders"
  - "AI Transformation for small & medium businesses"
- Products, from the homepage: "Tools built from real engagements."
- Product labels in the site's words:
  - "An AI operating system that amplifies every employee." (10x Employee)
  - "AI that runs inside your office, so client data stays there." (Private AI)
  - "Your own AI chief of staff." (AI Chief of Staff)
  - "Turn your positioning into a playbook, battlecards and call plans your reps will use." (listed on the homepage as "Sales Enablement Automation", but the page itself is titled "PositioningHQ")
- Workshops, from the homepage: "Hands-on workshops that build understanding, create clarity, and deliver outcomes you can act on."

## Audience named

| Page | Who | Quote |
|---|---|---|
| Home | Product and revenue leaders | "We help product and revenue leaders define and execute their product, growth, and AI transformation strategy." |
| Nav | SaaS founders, revenue leaders, small and medium businesses | See the three advisory lines above |
| /10x-ai-operating-system | Small business owners, CEOs of growing companies, startup founders | "Any company that hires faster than it can explain itself." |
| /private-ai | Regulated professional firms of 3 to 25 people | "Private AI for law firms, accounting firms, mortgage brokers and other regulated professionals"; "You run a firm of roughly 3 to 25 people." |
| /ai-accelerator | Owners, founders, CEOs, senior executives | "business owners, startup founders, CEOs and other senior executives who have the authority, the budget and the desire to move AI forward in their company." |
| /executive-ai-fluency | CEOs, founders, senior executives | "CEOs, founders and senior executives at growing companies." |
| /positioninghq | Sales teams and reps | "Every rep tells a different story." |
| /ai-chief-of-staff, /ai-use-policy-generator | No audience named | Not found |

**Gap:** The homepage speaks to "product and revenue leaders". Most product pages speak to CEOs, founders, owners and regulated firms. Only PositioningHQ (reps) and the advisory menu match the homepage audience.

## Value claims
Most prominent first.

1. "Hands-on advice from someone who has run the function." (Home)
2. "Tools built from real engagements." (Home)
3. "Hands-on workshops that build understanding, create clarity, and deliver outcomes you can act on." (Home)
4. "Make your next hire your first 10x employee." (/10x-ai-operating-system)
   - "One company Brain. Any AI model."
   - "Change models next year and you lose nothing."
5. "Run open-weight AI models inside your own firewall, so client information never leaves your office." (/private-ai)
6. "An AI that remembers your business." (/ai-chief-of-staff)
   - "Most AI forgets you the moment you close the tab."
7. "Answer seven questions. Get a one-page AI use policy your team will read, plus everything you need to roll it out." (/ai-use-policy-generator)
8. "One story, told the same way by every rep." (/positioninghq)
9. "Learn AI beyond the chatbot by building your own AI chief of staff and second brain, on your real work, in three sessions." (/executive-ai-fluency)
10. "A 2-day offsite to build your 2027 AI roadmap." (/ai-accelerator)

## Proof shown
- **Founder credentials (Home, /ai-accelerator):**
  - "Sam Rivera has spent 25 years building business software companies."
  - "As VP of Product at Galvanize, he helped scale the company to a $1B exit."
  - "As Chief Product & Technology Officer at Boast AI, he led the move to AI in how the company built and delivered its product."
- **Co-host credentials (/ai-accelerator):** Atta Emami has "more than 20 years" of experience and "6.5 years at Shopify". He also led change at AIG "reaching 22,000 employees and 3,800 line managers".
- **Testimonials:**
  - Laurie Schultz, "Board Director, Serial Chair, Investor, Technology CEO": "Sam is an experienced operator who has done this work himself. Working with him moved my understanding of AI forward quickly, and I now use it in my work every day." Appears on /ai-accelerator and /executive-ai-fluency.
  - Reza Varzidehkar, CEO, OVOU: "We've had noticeable productivity gains and better communication since our team started using our Claude assistant." Appears on /ai-chief-of-staff.
- **Anecdote (/executive-ai-fluency):** "A product recall, midway through." An unnamed CEO used the tool for board and customer communications.
- **Method claim, not customer proof (/10x-ai-operating-system):** "The Day-One Test", with a 1 hour setup and ten questions.
- **Customer logos:** None shown.
- **Customer results or numbers:** None shown. The only figures are the founder's career numbers and product specs.
- **Case studies:** None shown. The recall story is anonymous.
- **Awards:** None shown.
- **Not found:** The "How we know it works" and "Questions" sections show headings only. No answers were captured in the crawl.

## Tone
Plain, direct, practical, operator-led, confident.

Example line: "Stop asking AI questions. Start working with it." (/executive-ai-fluency)
